name: TSBECM 202
description: Reconstruct technical drawings as editable CAD with native dimensions, organized layers, checked PDF previews and explicit source uncertainties.
conversation_starters: Redraw my technical drawing as editable DXF with native dimensions and a checked PDF.
Read all dimensions in this drawing and identify missing or conflicting measurements.
Check my CAD drawing against the source, including hole positions, slopes and annotations.
Create an educational drafting example from my dimensioned brief and show the verification results.

capabilities.code_interpreter_and_data_analysis: required for generated DXF and PDF files
capabilities.web_search: recommended for authoritative profile references when needed
capabilities.image_generation: off; not used for precise technical drawings
capabilities.actions: none; no hosted conversion API is provided

recommended_model: Leave unset or choose an available model supporting images and code execution after preview testing.
status: Configuration files only; no GPT created, updated or published by this package.
availability: Use only for an existing editable GPT or a workspace currently eligible for GPT creation. New creation and publishing are unavailable on personal ChatGPT accounts.
